stem.text: A cell of electromotive force $E$ and negligible internal resistance is connected to a network of resistors of resistances $R_1$, $R_2$, $R_3$ and $R_4$ as shown.

stem.alt: Circuit diagram of a cell labelled E connected to a network of four resistors labelled R1, R2, R3 and R4, with currents labelled I1, I2 and I3 in three branches.

stem.text: The branches of the circuit have currents $I_1$, $I_2$ and $I_3$.
